name: Kamigawa
description: Kamigawa is a plane reminiscent of sengoku-era Japan, with two symbiotic worlds, the material utsushiyo and the kami spirit realm kakuriyo, and is the home of Kaito, Tamiyo and the Wanderer.

description_citations.text: "The Wanderer". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Kaito Shizuki". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

status.text: The material's events show Kaito working for technological progress and the Wanderer, its lost empress, seeking a way home, with Light-Paws as regent.

citations.text: "The Wanderer". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, six months ago, Nashi plays hide-and-seek in Tamiyo's library on Kamigawa and finds a pale giant, Ajani, who is welcomed into the household.
timeline.quote: A pale giant stared down at him. One blue eye blinked.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo introduces Ajani as part of her story-circle and Nashi as part of her family.
timeline.quote: He's part of our family now.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo privately asks Ajani where Elspeth is and he says she is not coming.
timeline.quote: Where is Elspeth?

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Nashi overhears Tamiyo tell Ajani that Nashi's village was burned by planeswalkers at the behest of the criminal Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: It was at the behest of a planeswalking criminal named Tezzeret.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Nashi remembers fleeing the fire as his mother was burned by a man of living flame.
timeline.quote: Mama's on fire, held aloft by a man of living flame.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo says Tezzeret died three years ago, killed by Nashi's villagers and betrayed by comrades.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret died...three years ago, I think?

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo comforts the sobbing Nashi and tells Ajani that actions have consequences.
timeline.quote: Actions have consequences,

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: In a flashback five months ago Ajani tells Nashi he is leaving Kamigawa to find the man who killed Nashi's family.
timeline.quote: To find the man who killed your family.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani confesses to Nashi that Elspeth is dead and that he lost her.
timeline.quote: Elspeth is dead.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani tells the children Elspeth's story, saying a monster struck her down in front of him.
timeline.quote: another monster struck her down

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani whispers that it should have been him, not Elspeth, and the children comfort him.
timeline.quote: It should have been me. Not her.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret travels to the ruins of his tower and resolves to wait for the winner of the war to weaken before making his move.
timeline.quote: Then—and only then—would he make his move.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Norn shows Tamiyo the night-lit city of Kamigawa and asks whether she still loves it and her family.
timeline.quote: Do you still care for your family?

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Realmbreaker pierces Kamigawa's city as Tamiyo watches a mother save her children, and a man in black deflects falling tiles.
timeline.quote: Realmbreaker pierces the earth.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: On Kamigawa, a boy returns home to his father with his mother, now a spirit of glowing characters.
timeline.quote: A spirit that hovers before him, holding his son's hand.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 10: The Rhythms of Life
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 10: The Rhythms of Life" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer recounts how Nashi followed his mother's voice to a carved door, sent drones through, and then went in with friends, after which the door vanished.
timeline.quote: He followed her call to a door covered in strange carvings, one that had no place in Kamigawa.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Back on Kamigawa, Nashi tells children the story of their adventure.
timeline.quote: watching as Nashi spun the story of their adventures to a crowd of rapt youngsters.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Yuriko strangles an Imperial guard in the dark and her girlfriend forges the tiger claws.
timeline.quote: Yuriko strangled him in the dark, and her girlfriend forged the famous tiger claws soon after.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo usurps the throne and Yuriko pledges her loyalty.
timeline.quote: When Tamiyo usurped the throne, Yuriko knew her time had come.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Day of Fallen Camellias ends with Tamiyo in the throne room and her husband free.
timeline.quote: The Day of Fallen Camellias ended with her in the throne room

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Kaito pursues a personal agenda of technological progress on Kamigawa, breaking rules to make the world better for himself and his family.
timeline.quote: He pursues a personal agenda of technological progress on his home plane of Kamigawa

citation.text: "Kaito Shizuki". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: It is revealed that Konda began the war by kidnapping a kami, with moonfolk aid, to secure his own power and immortality.
timeline.quote: With aid from moonfolk allies, Konda kidnapped a kami to secure his own power and immortality.

citation.text: "Kamigawa". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The kidnapping outrages O-Kagachi, igniting an ire that claims countless lives.
timeline.quote: This outraged the great O-Kagachi, kami of all things, igniting an ire that would claim countless lives.

citation.text: "Kamigawa". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: It is revealed to a select few that the Wanderer is the lost empress of Kamigawa, seeking a way home.
timeline.quote: the Wanderer is the lost empress of Kamigawa, seeking a way to finally return home for good.

citation.text: "The Wanderer". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: She is its Emperor and has left Light-Paws as regent.
relations.quote: she had asked Light-Paws to maintain her regency for now
